exact_reductions: For integral R_A, R_A<=S_m iff R_A<=floor(S_m); the irrational remainder has no integral carrier capacity.
For an already constructed typed carrier graph C_G, payment is equivalent to all Hall cuts, and the deficit is |D|-nu(C_G).
Exactly delta universal dummy carriers repair deficiency delta, but delta arbitrary actual carriers need not repair any deficient cut.
negative_evidence: The exact n=14 rainbow-C7 L4(2) maximum-witness graph has three repeated-colour demands, three distinct owned A diagonals, and only the two actual full-reserve carriers K(bc)={bc,cz}.
One-step rectangle naming, anonymous fractional slack, lossless circuit uncrossing without an exchange axiom, and unbounded-fibre boundary maps are invalid.
The scalar profile R_A>S_m alone gives no matching-rank bound in an actual exchange graph.

actual_carrier_firewall.demand: A concrete defect token (gamma,b) obtained from a repeated colour's independent outer endpoint set Y_gamma after choosing root r_gamma.
actual_carrier_firewall.old_actual_carrier: A concrete missing B-edge belonging to the canonical reserve K({r_gamma,b}) in the same original graph, after already committed carriers are removed.
actual_carrier_firewall.created_actual_carrier: A previously unused concrete missing B-edge of that same graph which becomes legally adjacent to a demand through an explicitly described root rotation, alternating exchange, absorber, or C7-derived switch.
actual_carrier_firewall.universal_dummy: A formal new right vertex adjacent to every demand. It proves only the min-max identity and is forbidden as positive carrier evidence.
actual_carrier_firewall.graph_realizable_certificate: The original labelled graph, A/B partition, repeated-colour endpoint data, canonical reserve calculation, before/after legal arcs, and ownership/nonreuse map must all be replayable.

inherited_methods.loss_step: Add delta anonymous right vertices and apply Hall.
inherited_methods.lost_information: Whether a missing B-edge exists in the original graph, which operation licenses it, and which deficient cuts it neighbours.
inherited_methods.exact_witness: Two demands with two new actual carriers both adjacent only to the first demand; the second singleton cut remains deficient.
inherited_methods.consequence: Every mechanism must construct cut-specific legal neighbourhoods before invoking Hall.

inherited_methods.loss_step: Call an owned missing A diagonal a new B token without changing a base pair or reserve.
inherited_methods.lost_information: Carrier shore type and the existence of a new missing B-edge.
inherited_methods.exact_witness: The n=14 tight circuit has three distinct A diagonals but K(bc)={bc,cz} and no third missing B-edge.
inherited_methods.consequence: A successful operation must modify the actual reserve incidence, not merely relabel an A atom.

inherited_methods.loss_step: Assume an unmatched demand can leave a terminal alternating component.
inherited_methods.lost_information: A graph-derived switch changing a root/base/reserve and a genuinely free endpoint carrier.
inherited_methods.exact_witness: The three-demand/two-carrier n=14 circuit is a terminal component under every root reversal because each Y_gamma={b,c} has the same base bc.
inherited_methods.consequence: Alternation rearranges existing carriers unless a rank-increasing graph move is exhibited.

inherited_methods.loss_step: Add owned-A rank to B-reserve transversal rank.
inherited_methods.lost_information: An exchange axiom whose fundamental circuit outputs remain legal missing B-edges.
inherited_methods.exact_witness: The n=14 circuit has A coverage rank three and B matching rank two but no B rank increase.
inherited_methods.consequence: Any matroidal route must first prove a common ground set and graph-realizable basis exchange.

inherited_methods.loss_step: Count many potential missing pairs without reserving distinct graph-derived absorption patterns.
inherited_methods.lost_information: Which demand is absorbable, whether the output is outside the occupied reserve, and overlap between absorbers.
inherited_methods.exact_witness: All three n=14 demands share the same two-token full reserve despite distinct owners.
inherited_methods.consequence: Reservoir size is irrelevant without cut expansion and bounded overlap.

inherited_methods.method: rotation or uncrossing by set algebra
inherited_methods.loss_step: Replace crossing tight demand sets by unions/intersections while assuming reserve incidence is preserved.
inherited_methods.lost_information: Root choice, base determinism K(e), and colour-specific C7 legality.
inherited_methods.consequence: Uncrossing must be implemented as an actual odd-cycle/root rotation with a rank comparison.

inherited_methods.loss_step: Treat candidate arcs or carriers as independent trials from their total count.
inherited_methods.lost_information: Perfect correlation caused by identical base pairs and identical canonical reserves.
inherited_methods.exact_witness: Three n=14 colours all have base bc and identical reserve {bc,cz}; random root reversal changes nothing.
inherited_methods.consequence: A nibble requires graph-proved codegree bounds and a deterministic cleanup of every leftover cut.

required_new_information: A legal graph operation which changes at least one demand's canonical reserve neighbourhood and provably increases matching rank.
For every deficient cut, an actual missing B-edge reached by that operation and not already occupied outside the cut.
An exchange-rank theorem on a common graph-realizable ground set, not the scalar sum of A and B ranks.
An overlap or ownership invariant preventing one created edge, absorber, or rotation certificate from being reused.
Composition of the carrier theorem with the exact outer-A gate and every public hard branch to obtain the frozen 1/8 conclusion.
forbidden_shortcut: No universal dummy, formal Hall completion, finite absence of a blocker, or scalar A+B/slack total is evidence of actual carrier creation.
